cases.scope: HTTP/2 responses with large non-stream Buffer or string bodies must arrive completely, including bodies larger than 64 KiB with an explicit Content-Length. cases.query: reply trailer handler callback promise first completion chunked framing Content-Length

requiredTargets.basis: Complete base function containing the behavior changed by the reference patch.

requiredPaths.reason: Existing behavioral test surface for the requested change.

cases.scope: When a reply trailer handler completes more than once, accept only its first completion. In particular, a handler that calls its callback and also resolves a promise must retain the callback value, while other asynchronous trailers still complete normally. Preserve successful payload delivery, declared trailer names and chunked framing without Content-Length.
